name: Garuda Indonesia

strictness.note: Existing type/region prior, not a researched enforcement rating.

allowances.note: Standard aircraft allowance. Garuda states that dimensions include wheels, handles and side pockets. Economy flights operated by CRJ or ATR aircraft instead use 41 × 34 × 17 cm and 92 cm linear, which the current aircraft-agnostic schema cannot select safely.
Garuda lists a laptop bag, handbag, purse or pocketbook as a free carry-on item but does not publish a separate numeric personal-item box.

research_scope: Standard adult Economy cabin and personal-item policy; the aircraft-specific CRJ/ATR cabin limit is documented but not activated.
audit_note: Official Garuda baggage page read directly. The main cabin rule has both per-axis and 115 cm linear limits. A smaller Economy allowance applies on CRJ and ATR aircraft, but the carrier schema cannot express aircraft applicability. Checked tables are route- and market-dependent and remain unresearched. Enforcement and physical sizer dimensions remain unresearched.
